Longteng Chen (陈龙腾)

2nd-year PhD student · Laboratoire de Mathématiques d'Orsay

Université Paris-Saclay

Orsay, France

I am a PhD student under the supervision of Alix Deruelle. My research lies at the interface of differential geometry and partial differential equations. I am currently studying the Kähler–Ricci flow emerging from singular spaces. I am also interested in related problems in canonical Kähler metrics, including Kähler–Ricci shrinkers and metrics of positive scalar curvature.

Geometric Analysis Complex Geometry Kähler–Ricci Flow Singular Spaces PDEs
